Abo abaakaafuwala ne baggya abantu ku Kkubo lya Allah (Allah) yayonoona emirimu gyabwe.

Ate abo abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu era ne bakkiriza ebyo ebyassibwa ku Muhammadi, era nga ge mazima agava ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe (abo Allah) yabasangulako ebisobyo byabwe era n'alongoosa embeera yaabwe.

Ekyo kiri bwekityo lwa kuba nti mazima bo abaakaafuwala baagoberera ebitali bituufu, ate nga abo abakkiriza baagoberera amazima agava eri Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe, bulijjo Allah bw'atyo akubira abantu ebifaananyi byabwe (bageraageranye).

Olwo bwe muba nga musisinkanye abo abaakaafuwala (mu lutalo) muteme ensingo, okutuusiza ddala nga mubanafuyizza, munyweze empingu (ze musiba nazo abawambe) olwo nno kiri gyemuli okubata oluvannyuma (lw'okubawamba) oba okubakkiriza okwenunula, (ekyo mukikole bwemutyo) okutuusa olutalo lweruggwa. Ekyo bwekityo bwekiri, naye singa Allah yayagala yandibewangulidde, wabula (ekimugaana okukola ekyo) lwakwagala kugezesa abamu mu mmwe nga akozesa abalala. Era abo abattibwa nga bali mu kulwana mu Kkubo lya Allah, (Allah) tagenda kwonoona mirimu gyabwe.
Ajja kubaluŋŋamya era alongoose n'embeera yaabwe.
Era abayingize Ejjana gye yabategeeza edda.
Abange mmwe abakkiriza singa mutaasa Allah, ajja kubataasa, era anyweze ebigere byammwe (abagumye).
N'abo abaakaafuwala okuzikirira kube ku bo, era Allah yayonoona emirimu gyabwe.
Ekyo lwa kuba nti mazima bo baakyawa ebyo Allah bye yassa, olwo nno n'ayonoona emirimu gyabwe.
Abaffe tebatambula mu nsi, olwo nno ne balaba nga bwe yali enkomerero yaabo abaaliwo olubereberye lwabwe, (anti) Allah yabazikiriza. Era abo abaakaafuwala ba kutuukwako ekiringa ekyo.
Ekyo nno lwa kuba nti mazima Allah Ye Mukuumi Wa Abakkiriza era nga ddala abawakanya Allah tebalina mukuumi.

Mazima Allah ajja kuyingiza abo abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu Ejjana nga emigga gikulukutira wansi waazo, ate abo abaakaafuwala ne beeyagalira (mu bulamu bw'okunsi) era ne balya ng'ensolo bwe zirya, kale Omuliro bwe buddo bwabwe.
Era ebitundu bimeka nga byo byali byamaanyi okusinga ekitundu kyo (Makka) ekyo ekyakugoba, abantu b'ebitundu ebyo twabazikiriza ne wataba abadduukirira.
Abaffe oyo aba ali ku bunnyonnyofu obuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi We ayinza okuba ng'oyo emirimu gye emibi egyamulabisibwa okuba nti mirungi, era (abantu abo) ne bagoberera okwagala kwabwe.

(Abaffe) endabika y'Ejjana eyo abatya Allah gye baalagaanyisibwa, erimu emigga egy'amazzi agatayonooneka n'emigga gy'amata agatakyuka mpooma yaago, n’emigga egy'omubisi oguliwoomera abanywi n'emigga gy'omubisi gw'enjuki omusengejje, nga bali mu yo balifuna ebibala byonna, era balifuna mu yo ekisonyiwo okuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe, oyinza okugigeraageranya ku oyo ow'okutuula mu Muliro obugenderevu nga era balinywesebwa olwegye lw'amazzi, olwo nno ne gakutulakutula ebyenda byabwe?!

Era mu bo mulimu abakuwuliriza (nga balaga nti bagonvu) okutuusa lwe bafuluma okuva wooli, bagamba abo abaaweebwa okumanya nti, abadde agamba ki emabegako awo? Abo nno beebo Allah be yassa envumbo ku mitima gyabwe era ne bagoberera okwagala kwabwe.
Ate abo abaaluŋŋama (Allah) abongera buluŋŋamu era n'abawa okutya kwabwe (Allah).

Abaffe balina kye balindirira okuggyako ekiseera eky'Enkomerero okuba nga kibajjira kibwatuukira ate nga ddala (obumu) ku bubonero bwakyo bumaze okujja, baliggya wa okubuulirirwa kwabwe (okulibagasa ekiseera) bwe kiribajjira?

Kale manya nti mazima tewali kisinzibwa mu butuufu okuggyako Allah era osabe ekisonyiwo olwe byonoono byo, era abakkiriza abasajja n'abakkiriza abakazi obasabire ekisonyiwo, era Allah amanyi entambula zammwe (nga mujjulukuka okuva mu kifo ne mudda mu kirala n'okuva ku kikolwa ne mudda ku kirala) era amanyi obuddo bwa mmwe.

Abo abakkiriza bagamba nti singa essura (eragira olutalo) essibwa, naye essura neemala essibwa nga eyogera mu bulambulukufu nga n'okulwana kwogerwako mu yo, olaba abo abalina obulwadde mu mitima gyabwe nga bakutunuulira entunula ey’omuntu azirise ku lwokutya okufa. Ekyalisinze obulungi gyebali.
(Kwe) kugonda, n'ebigambo ebirungi, naye ekigambo bwe kimala okukakata, kale singa batuukiriza bye balagaanyisa Allah kye kyalisinze obulungi gye bali.
Abaffe musuubira nti singa mukulembera (ne muba abafuzi) nti munayonoona mu nsi ne mukutula eŋŋanda zammwe.
(Abakola ebyo) abo beebo Allah be yakolimira n'abaggala amatu era n'aziba amaaso gaabwe.
Abaffe tebeetegereza Kulaani, oba emitima gy'egiriko ekkufulu zaagyo?!
Mazima abo abakyuka ne badda gye baava (nebaleka Obusiraamu) oluvanyuma lw’obuluŋŋamu okubeerambikira, Sitaane ye yabibalaga nti birungi era n'abasuubiza eby'obulimba.
Ekyo nno, lwa kuba nti mazima bo, bagamba abatayagala Allah bye yassa, nti tujja kubagondera mu bintu ebimu. Era bulijjo Allah amanyi ebyama byabwe.
Olwo nno baba ngeri ki Malayika bwezibatusaako entuuko zaabwe, nga zikuba ebyenyi byabwe n’obutuuliro bwabwe.
Ekyo (bwekityo bwekiriba) olw'okuba nti mazima bo baagoberera ebyo ebinyiiza Allah ne bakyawa okusiima Kwe, olwo nno n'ayonoona emirimu gyabwe.
Abaffe abo abalina obulwadde mu mitima gyabwe basuubira nti Allah tagenda kuggyayo bukukuuzi bwabwe (bwe balina ku Nnabbi Muhammadi).
Singa twagala twandibakulaze, Olwo nno wandibategedde olw'obubonero bwabwe, era ojja kubategeerera ddala okusinziira ku njogera yaabwe. Era Allah amanyi emirimu gyammwe.
Era tujja kubagezesa okutuusa lwe tunategeera abalafuubana mu mmwe mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah n'abagumikiriza, era tujja kugezesa ebigambo bya mmwe.

Mazima abo abaakaafuwala ne baziyiza abantu ku Kkubo lya Allah, ne beesimba mu Mubaka oluvannyuma lw'obuluŋŋamu okubeeyoleka, (abo) tebalina kabi konna ke bayinza kutuusa ku Allah, era ajja kusazaamu emirimu gyabwe.
Abange mmwe abakkiriza mugondere Allah, era mugondere Omubaka, era temwonoonanga emirimu gyammwe.
Mazima abo abaakaafuwala era ne balemesa abantu Eddiini ya Allah, oluvannyuma ne bafa nga bakaafiiri, Allah tagenda kubasonyiwa.
Temufootookereranga ne musaba emirembe ate nga mmwe baawaggulu, era nga Allah ali wamu na mmwe, era nga tagenda kukendeeza mpeera ya mirimu gyammwe.
Mazima obulamu bw'ensi muzannyo na binyumu, naye bwe mukkiriza era ne mutya Allah, ajja kubawa empeera yammwe, ate nga tabasabye mmaali yammwe.
Singa agibasaba n'abapeeka mujja kukodowala, olwo nno n'assa mu bbanga obukukuuzi bwammwe.

Abaffe mmwe, mmwe beebo abakoowoolwa mube nga muwaayo mu Kkubo lya Allah, olwo nno mu mmwe ne mubaamu akodowala, so nga omuntu akodowala, mazima yeekodowalira yekka nga ate Allah y'atalina kye yeetaaga ate nga mmwe muli beetaavu, naye bwe munakyuka (ne muva ku Ddiini) ajja kuleeta abantu abalala abatali mmwe, oluvannyuma tebagenda kuba nga mmwe.
